title: 云原生平台工程与 AI Agent 基础设施简报
english: Recent CNCF and OpenAI updates highlight two connected priorities for senior operations and development engineers. CNCF’s Platform Engineering Day at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026 focuses on how platform teams can help developers access AI and cloud-native capabilities safely and efficiently. Another CNCF article examines ownership of NIS2 and DORA responsibilities on Kubernetes platform teams, emphasizing the need to provide evidence for regulatory controls. OpenAI reports that Sophos reduced threat-investigation time by 96% and automated 52% of MDR cases with Daybreak while preserving human oversight. Asana reportedly reduced browser-test model costs by 76x and improved speed by 5x using a more capable model in Codex.
chinese: 这些信息共同指向平台工程、合规治理和 AI Agent 运行效率的结合。CNCF 关注平台团队如何让开发者安全、高效地使用 AI 与云原生能力，也讨论 Kubernetes 平台团队如何承担 NIS2 和 DORA 相关责任并提供控制证据。OpenAI 的案例显示，Sophos 使用 Daybreak 将威胁调查时间缩短 96%，并自动化 52% 的 MDR 案例，同时保留人工监督；Asana 则在浏览器测试中将模型成本降低 76 倍、速度提升 5 倍。对资深运维开发而言，平台能力不仅要提供基础设施，还要覆盖安全边界、审计证据、成本控制和人工介入机制。
why_it_matters: 这直接关联云原生平台工程、AIOps 和 Agent Infra：平台团队需要设计安全且高效的 AI 能力接入方式，建立 Kubernetes 环境中的合规责任与证据链，并关注 Agent 工作流的成本、速度和人工监督。对职业发展而言，能够同时理解平台工程、监管控制、AI 运维自动化和成本治理，将有助于承担更综合的技术领导职责。
interview_expression: I see platform engineering as more than infrastructure provisioning; it also establishes secure access, compliance evidence, and operational guardrails for AI workloads. In AI-assisted operations, I would measure automation by both efficiency gains and the quality of human oversight.

vocabulary.example: Platform engineering helps developers access infrastructure and AI capabilities safely and efficiently.
The team must provide evidence that each regulatory control is implemented and reviewable.
The workflow uses automation while preserving human oversight for critical decisions.
